notes.title: Cash consumption event notice & Upcoming update
notes.notes:
Hello Rakioners,

we will have Surprise event during 2 weeks
You can see the detail as below


[Cash Consumption events]
1. Period : 11st June ~ 24th June
2. Rewards : 

1 Cash            -  1st Gacha ticket(1EA)
1000 Cash      -  1st Gacha ticket(5EA)
10,000 Cash  -  1st Gacha ticket(10EA)


[Upcoming update]

We've observe how well you played, how far you reached on level, battle, stages. 
We think that "Advanced class" is somewhat too early in this situation, therefore we will add other things

1. Modes
After 25th June we can play Zombie & Boss war in Rakion Steam, 

2. Creatures
We will add 'Archangle, Human Monster, Grim Reaper, Gargoyle, Yeti, BombNak, Destroyer, DesertHound, TwinheadDragon' on Gacha system

3. Master & Pupil system will be updated. Now you can invite & help your friend by getting your own benefit



I hope you will like our update contents. we are still working on how to improve the server ping situation, and most appropriate resolution. 

Thank you for your love on Rakion Chaos Force
